conclusions: This report covers all 653 generated entries in 395 input-supported recorded markets from the 21–22 September long session, out of 818 entries in the expanded campaign. All 20 unchanged rules and the immediate-exit control use the same entries and starting shares.

With every residual quantity valued at its last recorded positive bid, R007 has the lowest full-cohort loss: $1,421.28 versus $2,509.31 for immediate exit, a $1,088.04 reduction. These totals include assumed sales and recorded fee estimates, not verified executable closeouts.

R007 requires 294 assumed residual closeouts covering 66,458.67 shares, or 84.45% of its starting shares; immediate exit requires one for 20 shares. Retained positive bids can be stale or followed by a zero bid, and the assumption does not constrain sale quantity to displayed depth.

R001 has the highest saved-per-lot-hour ratio: $200.84 saved over 93.93 lot-hours, or $2.14 per lot-hour. R007 saves $1,088.04 over 3,935.33 lot-hours, or $0.28 per lot-hour. Lot-hours measure time until each lot is flat, including overlap and gaps; they do not measure lost rewards or shared-capital return.

For the 470 entries at least six calendar hours before cutoff, R006 and R016 each lose $1,082.11, R007 loses $1,103.92, and immediate exit loses $2,005.89. The full-cohort loss ordering therefore changes in this recorded-data sensitivity; the other 183 later entries remain in the main results.

R007 has lower loss than control on 313 entries, higher loss on 270, and ties on 70; median savings is effectively zero. Its best market supplies $694.70 of the $1,088.04 total savings. Entries and markets are clustered, so these counts do not establish future superiority.

Five full three-hour UTC entry windows contain 518 entries; the two partial edges contain 135. Each window follows its entries through the common recording cutoff, rather than measuring a fixed three-hour outcome.

R008 and R015 lose $2,715.43 and $2,798.34, respectively, versus the $2,509.31 control. All rules remain in the report. This single historical batch does not establish a profitable bot or a proven live winner.

research2.scope: Common recorded entries with a known positive reward minimum of 50 shares or fewer at placement.
assumptions: Matched independent common-entry lots, not shared-capital bot P/L, executable liquidation proof or ROI.
Frozen Research1 handling rules; known positive reward minimum of 50 shares or fewer at order placement.
Normal exits remain the frozen simulated rule exits. Closing book routes are counterfactual estimates, not new policy fills.
Final residual value uses qualified recorded bid depth or opposite-token ask depth plus merging. Routes are alternatives; mirrored depth is never added.
Book observations must be at most30seconds old at the cutoff and pass the recorded gap/invalidation checks; older or invalidated depth is not credited as an exit.
Shares not covered by a route remain UNSOLD and are valued at the last recorded trade-price report. This is a mark, not sale proceeds.
A last-trade report in a book does not establish when that trade happened. Observation age is not actual trade age.
Recorded trading fees are included for modeled trades. No fictitious executed exit fee is charged on unsold marks. Unknown prices or fees are not silently zeroed.
Merge network/relayer costs and latency are unmeasured and outside this trading-P/L estimate. Independent lots do not compete for shared book depth.
Holding lot-hours sum overlapping lots and include gaps; they are not missed rewards or lost farming time.
Late fills have shorter follow-up. This recording is under24hours and does not count as a full24hour elimination day. No rule is removed.
Missed rewards are excluded. R020 reward trigger remains excluded.
conclusions: This closed Research2 recording spans 19h38m35s and contains 337 common simulated fills from 229 supported recorded markets with reward minimum at most 50 shares. All 20 experimental rules and the control remain in the comparison.

The immediate-exit control is fully closed in the simulation and lost $677.89 on the same entries. Saved is the difference in marked trading P/L against that control, not reward income or cash earned.

The graph shows 21 sampled historical points on an expanding common cohort. UNSOLD holdings use last recorded trade-price reports; those marks are not guaranteed sale proceeds or proof of fresh trades.
Holding lot-hours sum overlapping independent lots, including gaps. This is not shared-capital bot equity, ROI or lost farming time. The recording is under 24 hours and no rule is eliminated.

mutations.name: Quick reset
mutations.description: Hold 5 minutes, then exit.

mutations.name: Short pause
mutations.description: Hold 15 minutes, then exit.

mutations.name: Half-hour reset
mutations.description: Hold 30 minutes, then exit.

mutations.name: One-hour recovery window
mutations.description: Hold 1 hour, then exit.

mutations.name: Two-hour recovery window
mutations.description: Hold 2 hours, then exit.

mutations.name: Patient four-hour window
mutations.description: Hold 4 hours, then exit.

mutations.name: Extended six-hour window
mutations.description: Hold 6 hours, then exit.

mutations.name: Scratch after fees
mutations.description: Exit when the complete position can break even after fees; otherwise 6 hours.

mutations.name: Recover one quarter
mutations.description: Exit after recovering 25% of the immediate-exit loss; otherwise 4 hours.

mutations.name: Recover one half
mutations.description: Exit after recovering 50% of the immediate-exit loss; otherwise 4 hours.

mutations.name: Recover three quarters
mutations.description: Exit after recovering 75% of the immediate-exit loss; otherwise 6 hours.

mutations.name: Relax the recovery target
mutations.description: Require 75% recovery in hour 1, 50% in hour 2, then 25%; exit by 4 hours.

mutations.name: Confirm the recovery
mutations.description: Require 50% recovery on at least 3 distinct books spanning 60 seconds; exit by 4 hours. Gaps reset confirmation.

mutations.name: Protect a rebound
mutations.description: Arm after 50% recovery; exit if loss worsens from its best by 25% of initial loss. Exit by 6 hours.

mutations.name: Scratch or cut deterioration
mutations.description: Exit at break-even or when loss reaches 150% of the immediate-exit loss; otherwise 2 hours.

mutations.name: Leave a stalled recovery
mutations.description: Exit after 1 continuously observed hour without an improvement of at least 5% of initial loss; otherwise 4 hours. Gaps reset the stall clock.

mutations.name: Exit a fading rebound
mutations.description: After 50% recovery, exit on 3 consecutive worsening fresh books; otherwise 4 hours. Gaps reset the sequence.

mutations.name: Halve risk, then recover
mutations.description: Sell half immediately. Exit the rest when combined loss is at most 50% of the immediate-exit loss; otherwise 4 hours.

mutations.name: Four-step exit
mutations.description: Sell cumulative 25%, 50%, 75%, 100% at 15, 30, 60, 120 minutes, limited by available depth.

mutations.name: Cap the reward sacrifice
mutations.description: Exit after 50% recovery or when missed rewards reach 25% of the initial loss; otherwise 4 hours. Unknown rewards cannot trigger the budget rule.
